values.meaning: slow duration range based on distance traveled
values.quote: {{pp|type=distance traveled|2 to 4 by 0.2|0 to 2750|formula = ''Capped at 2750 range.''}} seconds
values.binNote: Wiki gives min/max duration 2 to 4 seconds directly matching NamiR.MinSlowDuration=2 and NamiR.MaxSlowDuration=4. NamiR.DistToSlowRatio=0.002 would imply a 2750-range wave adds only 2750*0.002=5.5s beyond min if additive, or does not obviously reduce to the wiki's 'by 0.2' per some distance step description; the exact interpolation formula (how DistToSlowRatio maps distance to the 2-4s range) is not stated in either source, so the ratio itself is not separately restated as a duration number here.

mechanics.claim: Casting the ultimate immediately triggers Nami's passive buff on herself.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Surging Tides|Nami}} will trigger immediately on '''Nami''' on-cast.

mechanics.claim: The wave is a projectile that travels in the target direction, dealing damage and knock-up as it hits enemies, not instantly on cast.
mechanics.quote: Nami surges a tidal wave in the target direction ... dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Tidal Wave can be blocked by spell shields.
